items.prompt: White to move. Who has the initiative: the side whose moves carry threats the other must answer?

claims.statement: If White passes, Black cannot win material.
This is the engine's first choice.
The engine at depth 16 rates White at least two and a half pawns better.

hints: List what each side threatens. A threat here means a move that would win material or mate if the other side did nothing.
Ask first: if White passed, could Black win anything? Then ask: does White have a move that wins something or forces a reply?
The side whose moves carry threats the other must answer has the initiative. If neither side has any, nobody has it.
items.explain: Black has no threat of its own, while White has a move that wins material or forces a reply. White has the initiative by this lesson's definition.
